description: This file defines the PathValidator class in Drupal, responsible for validating paths and checking access permissions using different routers and request contexts.

classes.name: PathValidator
classes.description: Provides path validation and access checking functionality within Drupal, utilizing different routers and request contexts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PathValidator with access-aware and unaware routers, user account, and path processor.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given path is valid.

methods.name: getUrlIfValid
methods.description: Returns a URL object if the path is valid.

methods.name: getUrlIfValidWithoutAccessCheck
methods.description: Returns a URL object if the path is valid, without performing access checks.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Helper method to generate a URL object from a path, considering access checks.

methods.name: getPathAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves routing attributes for a given path, handling exceptions and access control.
